changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Backfill version bindings for quality rules created with only the rule-level dataset ID
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_rule_binding ( id, rule_version_id, dataset_id, scope_type, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), version.id, rule.dataset_id, 'DATASET', 'liquibase-quality-binding-backfill', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'liquibase-quality-binding-backfill', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM gov_rule_version version INNER JOIN gov_rule rule ON rule.id = version.rule_id WHERE rule.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gov_rule_binding binding WHERE binding.rule_version_id = version.id );
